searchText: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/polar-bear-selected-as-mascot-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008 https://0xhalfbloodprince.substack.com/p/an-african-cypherpunk-technomanci?r=75on3q&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&triedRedirect=true <@427491045308235776> are you the maintainer of the hardware requirements EIP? It occurs to me that it may be good to add recommendations for P2P bidders. Specially since we can envision a future where they will be the fallback and will be forced to be able to prove blocks. At Gloas it'll be fine to require from them fiber connections to be able to subscribe to all topics and flood publish sidecars
